own_solution.law: Simple pendulum, small-angle: T = 2 pi sqrt(L/g)

notes: Base: L/g = 0.8/9.8 = 4/49, sqrt = 2/7, T = 4 pi/7 = 1.7952 s. With the 0.4 m cord inserted, L = 1.2 m: sqrt(1.2/9.8) = 0.34993, T = 2.1987 s. Mass enters the equation of motion (m g sin theta = m L theta'') and cancels, so the mass sentences are C. Cord-in-drawer and cord-on-wall are D. Paired sentences use the same 0.4 m and 0.5 kg values. The brass-sphere sentence adds material but the bob is still small, so it remains a point mass at the stated precision.
